release_notes: v9.8.36 (restore-v931-fetch-behaviour) — CRITICAL hotfix after v9.8.35 hung Krishna Sales Corp. v9.8.35's adaptive splitter + 180s default EXPORT_TIMEOUT combined into an unintended doom-loop: a slow monthly sales request → 180s timeout → split into halves → each half 180s → eventually 30 single-day requests × 180s = ~90 minutes HAMMERING Tally on April 2025 alone, never reaching May. From the user's log the agent spun on April and never progressed. v9.8.36 reverts the fetch path to v9.8.31 semantics: single request per voucher-type per month, timeout = return empty + MOVE ON. EXPORT_TIMEOUT is now opt-in only (default 0 = use REQUEST_TIMEOUT). Admins with heavy ledgers can still set EXPORT_TIMEOUT=180 in a `.env` next to the .exe for extended waits WITHOUT the recursive-splitting doom-loop. Multi-company GUID binding, kill-switch, Busy integration — all preserved. If a tenant's data loss on empty-timeout months becomes a problem, we'll address with proper incremental sync (not adaptive splitting). Rebuild via `build-kit\build.bat`.
